audit.whatIsWrong: The Wind Wall interaction was written backwards and inconsistently. Sion's E is flagged as a projectile, so Wind Wall DOES delete it; Decimating Smash is a ground slam and Wind Wall does NOT stop it. The page said the opposite in wants.foe[1] ('use Wind Wall to angle-block your charged Q') and hedged in whys[2] ('hide the charge so he cannot simply Wind Wall it'), while spikes[0] and early stated it correctly. One page, two answers.
audit.why: This is the single decisive interaction of the matchup and the user was told to hide the one ability Wind Wall cannot touch while walking his E into the wall.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall now consistently blocks E and never Q, across tldr, focus, whys[2], wants.foe[1], dosFull[0] and the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every tracked-cooldown field named 'Yasuo Decimating Smash'. Decimating Smash is SION'S Q — Yasuo does not have an ability by that name. Separately, Wind Wall was quoted at 'roughly 30 seconds at early ranks' (it is 25/23/21/19/17) and Last Breath at 'a three-second cooldown' (it is 70/50/30).
audit.why: The focus field, the loading screen, the do's and the cooldown breakdown were all telling the user to track the enemy's use of his own ability. The Last Breath figure was off by an order of magnitude.
audit.corrected: Tracked cooldown changed to Wind Wall with its real 25s rank-1 timer; Last Breath corrected to 30s at rank 3.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are the lull for both of you — his damage is fine but not yet crit-scaling, and your stun is readable without minion cover to obscure your charge. Use E armor-shred to create freeze pressure and deny him safe CS steps. At level 6 the math shifts: his Last Breath can follow up any airborne effect, including your own R knockup if you drive through him, so think before you charge in — use R to engage on YOUR terms and land the charged Q stun before he can dash to a new minion and reset his position. His Wind Wall is on a long cooldown (roughly 30 seconds at early ranks); if he burns it defensively to block a Q or a skill shot, that is your all-in window — commit the full Q-E combo while it is down.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are the lull for both of you — his damage is fine but not yet crit-scaling, and your stun is readable without minion cover to obscure your charge. Use E armor-shred to create freeze pressure and deny him safe CS steps. At level 6 the math shifts: his Last Breath can follow up any airborne effect, including your own R knockup if you drive through him, so think before you charge in — use R to engage on YOUR terms and land the charged Q stun before he can dash to a new minion and reset his position. Wind Wall is 25 seconds at rank 1 and it only stops your E, never the Q slam; the moment he spends it on your shockwave, commit the full combo.

edits.before: Your W-shield at two items is enormous and your zombie passive means even a losing fight costs him HP he cannot ignore, but his Infinity Edge crit DPS and constant dashing make the extended 1v1 increasingly uncomfortable for you — he can weave in and out of your Q charge range indefinitely. Play for side-lane pressure with your zombie threat rather than solo-fighting a fed Yasuo; your R is a team fight engage tool and your bulk means you survive long enough for your team to follow. If you are ahead, end the game before his third item — a fully crit-stacked Yasuo with Last Breath on a three-second cooldown will eventually outrace your HP stacking.
